missing: Whether the Steam Deck actually reaches 4K on a TV through each dock (versus the advertised HDMI 2.1 4K/120Hz), what that means for a 4K TV owner, and how fast it charges during heavy gaming, including which power adapter to use when none is in the box.
why: Two major reviewers, PCGamesN and GamesRadar+, answer this exact question with their own testing (GamesRadar+ even has a 'Best for TV' pick), and Pocket Tactics adds a third tested roundup. The 4K TV and charging constraints don't narrow the field because nearly every dock has HDMI out and 100W pass-through. The remaining niche and listicle pages only add spec comparisons.
